_comment: short-video-builder per-project config. Copied to <your-projects-root>/<project>/short-video-builder/config.json on the first run; the agent fills missing values from chat and copies them into clips.json. objective: reach, leads or authority. duration: length bounds of each short in seconds (spec field duration_limits). transcription.engine: auto, faster-whisper, whisper-cpp, openai-whisper or import; model: whisper size (medium by default; small mishears too much for on-screen captions in most languages); whisper_cpp_model: path to a ggml file; names_to_spell: proper nouns and acronyms that prime the transcriber and guide proofreading (context.json names are added). style: brand_json points to project-context/brand.json, empty fields take its accent, text, bg and body font; uppercase, words_per_line (1 to 5), position (lower or middle), logo (PNG path or null), progress_bar (true or false). speaker: lower third, empty name = none. cta: optional end card after the last word, the source keeps playing under it; there is no intro card option, by design. audio: loudness target in LUFS, true peak in dBTP and light denoise. review_rounds_max: render review rounds before delivering with the open items listed (3). Optional: a "tools" object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json, for example {"vision": "manual", "critic": "builtin"}) overrides the project's tools.json for this agent.
